summary: GLM-5.3-Flash, Qwen3.8-Flash-Next and the DeepSeek profiles serve lossless FP4-CSF checkpoints by default, GLM gets routed-expert precision options, and glm53-tp2 is the new default GLM TP2 recipe
compatibility: These profiles now download and serve their FP4-CSF checkpoints; CHECKPOINT=original serves the original checkpoint as before. An image whose vLLM cannot read a model's FP4-CSF checkpoint serves the original with a warning. GLM routed experts on B12X now take BF16 activations with FP32 router weights by default, the Spark TP2 preset included; EXPERT_ACTIVATIONS=fp4 restores FP4 activations.
details: CHECKPOINT=csf (default) or original chooses the checkpoint of GLM-5.3-Flash (GLM-5.3-Flash-NVFP4-CSF-QAD), Qwen3.8-Flash-Next (Qwen3.8-Flash-Next-NVFP4-MXFP8-CSF-QAD), DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash (DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-lossless-CSF), DeepSeek-V4-Flash (DeepSeek-V4-Flash-0731-lossless-CSF) and DeepSeek-V4-Flash Vision (DeepSeek-V4-Flash-Vision-Exp-lossless-CSF). They hold the same weights as the originals with losslessly compressed routed-expert scales, which stay compressed in GPU memory and leave more room for the KV cache. The launcher downloads them and gives vLLM a generated directory that points at the weights.
DeepSeek-V4-Flash and its vision variant also need the deepseek_v4_flash family in the image's vLLM MXFP4-CSF loader; images without it serve the original checkpoint.

New GLM options: EXPERT_ACTIVATIONS (bf16, fp4), ROUTER_WEIGHTS (fp32, bf16) and PREFILL_ACTIVATIONS (a16, a4). a4 runs routed-expert calls of at least 1,536 tokens with NVFP4 activations when the image's B12X and vLLM include that path; decode always stays on BF16 activations. a4 needs EXPERT_ACTIVATIONS=bf16.

PRESET=glm53-tp2 serves the stored QAD checkpoint GLM-5.3-Flash-NVFP4-MXFP8-CSF-QAD on two 96-GB GPUs with BF16 expert activations, FP32 router weights, TP2/DCP2, MTP3, eight request slots and an 8 GiB KV cache per GPU. It serves only its own checkpoint, so CHECKPOINT=original is refused; glm53-spark-tp2 stays available.

Measured with glm53-tp2 on two RTX PRO 6000 Max-Q: prefill 7,490 and 7,728 tok/s at 8K and 32K tokens and decode about 171 tok/s for one request and 536 for eight. PREFILL_ACTIVATIONS=a4 raised prefill to 8,965 and 9,194 tok/s at the same decode speed; the needle-checksum near-miss rate was 0.53% with a16 and 1.75% with a4.
